reason: The cursor-field rest position, falloff and layer opacity parameters (restX, restY, falloff, layerOpacity) are schema fields no cursor-field runtime reads (M5.11 built the image-reveal type and left these, which predate it); they are read or retired before the final acceptance in M6.7.

The magnet moving-part parameter (data-sgs-fx-magnet-moving-part) is not read: M5.4 built the engage mode and pull model, but moving a part needs the part-to-selector contract in the runtime; it is built or retired before the final acceptance in M6.7.

The scroll-driven `sgs-post-card-enter` block (animation: sgs-post-card-enter linear, animation-timeline: view()) is deleted by another unit; M5.18 leaves that block untouched. Delete this entry with the block.
